advisories.title: NJ TRANSIT Offers Rail Service between Secaucus Junction/Hoboken Terminal and MetLife Stadium for Jets vs. Browns – Sunday, October 11, 2026

regionalAdvisories.title: On Sunday, October 11, all NJ TRANSIT rail service (except ACRL) will operate on a Portal Cutover weekend schedule. Midtown Direct service will operate to/from PSNY. Beginning Monday, October 12, all rail service (except ACRL) will operate on Portal Cutover weekday schedules with weekday cross honoring options for Midtown Direct customers diverted to Hoboken.
